estimator_bucket_note: The frozen structured-TSA estimator retains the exact preceding group-search semantics; its hidden bucket also includes the tiny set of layer-indexed 1D scales. LR routing instead places 1D layer scales in rest to match optimizer tensor groups.

floor_map.rationale: Map the frozen alpha range [0,0.65] monotonically onto the already studied 5%-15% floor range; no new-run tuning.

matched_uniform_definition: parameter-count-weighted arithmetic mean of the mapped per-parameter floor coefficients, computed from the restored model before training
primary_contrast: structured(mapped) minus structured(matched_uniform), reported as BPB(reference)-BPB(candidate); positive favors mapped
primary_interaction: [raw(mapped)-raw(matched_uniform)] - [structured(mapped)-structured(matched_uniform)]; positive means mapped allocation is more favorable under structured TSA
purpose: Predeclared test of whether frozen parameterwise TSA heterogeneity predicts parameterwise terminal learning-rate floors.

schedule_bucket_semantics.hidden: matrix-valued tensors carrying a transformer-layer index (the native hidden matrix block)
schedule_bucket_semantics.rest: 1D layer scales plus non-layer scalar/other parameters

secondary_contrasts: structured(mapped) minus raw(uniform05) as full-recipe gain
structured minus raw within each arm
uniform10 versus uniform05 schedule-estimator interaction on the new streams
selection_policy: No development search, no coefficient fitting, no arm selection. All four arms and all reported contrasts are frozen before training.
